# RepairPRO Release Checklist

- [ ] Version and release type approved.
- [ ] Scope and known issues documented.
- [ ] Lint, unit, integration and end-to-end tests pass.
- [ ] Tenant / branch isolation tests pass.
- [ ] Financial and stock integrity tests pass.
- [ ] Offline and synchronization recovery tested.
- [ ] Backup restore verified.
- [ ] Security and dependency scans reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets or customer data in artifacts.
- [ ] Windows installer clean install / upgrade / uninstall tested.
- [ ] Code signing and checksum verified.
- [ ] Release notes and migration instructions prepared.
- [ ] Licence, privacy and support impact reviewed.
- [ ] Rollback plan approved.
